clearedSpotChecks.check: Lagoon Sequencer Defined Metering: does the out-of-EVM ETH movement of the post-exec refund reach the PoolManager's balance or a settlement decision.
clearedSpotChecks.note: docs.optimism.io/op-stack/features/sdm, fetched today, says the 0x7D post-exec transaction is not executed as code, is not user-submittable, cannot rebate deposits, and re-settles by crediting the sender and debiting the fee recipients; a refund never exceeds measured gas. The PoolManager is never a transaction sender and is not an OP Stack fee vault. Native settlement counts msg.value (src/PoolManager.sol:354) and ERC-20 settlement takes the balance difference inside the same call (src/PoolManager.sol:285, 358-360), so a balance change outside the EVM after execution cannot create a delta. One wording detail: the docs say the difference is re-settled within the same transaction rather than after it, which changes nothing because it still happens outside EVM execution. The SDM actor would be operator in any case, since only the sequencer writes the refunds.
